penalty: liable to fine or community service
text: If a person secretly steals the property of another, the person is liable to a fine or community service or correctional labour or arrest or restraint of liberty.
If the theft is combined with entering a dwelling, the person shall be punished by imprisonment for three to six years.
If a person openly takes the property of another, the person shall be punished by restraint of liberty or imprisonment for up to four years.
If a person unlawfully appropriates a found thing of special historical or cultural value, the person is liable to a fine or correctional labour.
If a person finds a lost thing, the person must immediately notify the owner or hand the thing over to the police.
If the owner of a lost thing is not found within six months, the finder may keep the thing.
If a person intentionally kills another person, the person shall be punished by imprisonment for seven to fifteen years.

penalty: be punished by restraint or imprisonment
text: If a person kills another person by negligence, the person shall be punished by restraint of liberty or imprisonment for up to five years.
A person who harms an attacker in necessary defence is exempt from criminal liability.
If a person intentionally destroys or damages the property of another, the person is liable to a fine or restraint of liberty.
A person who damages the property of another must compensate the damage in full.
